title: Pathwise Random Hamiltonian Simulation
summary: Randomized product formulas such as qDrift offer a resource-efficient alternative to deterministic Trotter--Suzuki decompositions for Hamiltonian simulation, removing their polynomial dependence on the number of Hamiltonian terms. qDrift, however, is intrinsically limited to first order in the evolution time, so its query complexity remains linear in the inverse of the target accuracy, $1/ε$.
